title: votes: no way to show the tally for one task id (cmd_votes lists everything)
desc: cormac's #029fead6/#29436393: cmd_votes prints every under-vote task; there is no votes <id> form, so checking one task reprints all and was part of the retry-confusion around the t-8420 crash. Accept: votes <task-id> prints only that task's tally (and exits non-zero if it is not under vote), documented in help. Small, unowned.
